steps.step: GD1.exact Gauss law with dynamical truncated U(1) links (E_max = 1) and two-component Weyl hoppings: [H, G_x] = 0 and [G_x, G_y] = 0 for every vertex
steps.detail: max |[H, G_x]| = 0.0e+00, max |[G_x, G_y]| = 0.0e+00; Hilbert dimension 20736

steps.step: GD2.process invariance: every primitive gate (four link hoppings, four electric terms, the plaquette term) commutes with every G_x, so each single gate keeps a physical state physical
steps.detail: max |[gate, G_x]| = 0.0e+00; sector with one static charge (one fermion + flux strings), physical dimension 18; max leakage under single gates 0.0e+00

steps.step: GD3.static charges +-1 at adjacent vs opposite corners (fermion-free physical sector): at strong coupling the extra flux link costs ~ g^2/2 (string), the ratio tends to 1 as g^2 grows
GD4.truncation: E_max = 1 and 2 give the same strong-coupling static potential within O(1/g^4)

GD5.(statement) Gauss law and per-gate invariance are exact for dynamical U(1) links on the bcc plaquette; NOT shown: massless photons in the infinite-volume limit, SU(2)/SU(3), the joint Gate B + C test
steps.detail: Gate C: first exact checkpoint only
